 The Chicago Bulls battle the Milwaukee Bucks in the Bucks' home opener, which will be played in the late afternoon on Friday due to the World Series unfolding in Milwaukee as well. Chicago opened its season with a 135-92 loss at Toronto on Wednesday, while Milwaukee dropped a 128-116 decision at Washington that same night. The Bulls (0-1), who finished fourth in the Central Division at 31-51 a year ago, are 13-29 on the road since the start of last season. The Bucks (0-1), who finished third in the division at 32-50 in 2025-26, were 19-22 on their home court.
